description: V6.4.4 canonical trade capacity model (FIX-01/04/05/06). Physical resource capacity = workfront_count × max_crews_per_workfront × workers_per_crew, subject to trade-specific constraints. Every value is a conservative construction-organisation default with NO field evidence; status=provisional and must be re-baselined with site_observed / contractor_confirmed data before being read as fact.

provenance.workers_per_crew_source: workers_per_crew defaults to productivity_rates.default_crew_size; this file only references it, never redefines a productivity rate.
provenance.workfront_source: config/spatial_model.json (recommended_zone_area_sqm=2000) is the single canonical section size; this file does not invent a second area divisor.
provenance.congestion_source: config/resource_constraints.json congestion_model.crew_efficiency_table (crew is not linear productivity).
provenance.note: All capacity figures are planning constructs, not measurement. status=provisional, source_type=inherited_assumption, confirmed_by=null.

workfront.note: ceil() (not floor()) avoids the hard topology cliff documented in FIX-09: floor(3000/2500)=1 vs floor(6000/2500)=2 previously caused an unexplained sectional doubling. This derivation is the SAME one the spatial engine already uses (spatial_model.json zone_generation.by_area).

default_capacity.basis: One trade crew occupies one 2000 sqm workfront at a time (conservative: no multi-crew parallelism assumed without contractor evidence).

known_limits: max_crews_per_workfront 在 default_capacity 内保守取 1；但按工序声明 workers_per_workfront 的条目（v3.8, 2026-09-23）改由该字段决定每面人数上限，不再走 max_crews × crew。
workers_per_crew 继承 productivity_rates.default_crew_size (4-6)；逐工序覆盖需 basis + confirmed_by (GOV-09)。
工作面数在 max_workfronts=8 处饱和。按 v3.8 容量口径（500㎡/面），饱和面积为 8×500=4000㎡；此后容量不再增长，工期须实质拉长。旧文本 '~16000 sqm' 对应已废弃的 2000㎡/面 口径。

calibration_2026_09_23.what: 容量分区面积与每面人数上限按工序覆盖，取自各工序 crew_scaling。
calibration_2026_09_23.why: PM 2026-09-23 给的工序下限，用引擎自身工效反推，要求容量声明与工期声明自洽。原 2000㎡/面 × 1 班组口径与 PM 下限直接矛盾。
calibration_2026_09_23.not_changed: b0/b_min/b_max 全部未动；workfront.recommended_zone_area_sqm 未动（那是交接拓扑的离散口径，与容量刻意分离，改它会造排期 cliff）。

quantity_scope_ruling_2026_09_23.what: PM 就 v3.8 遗留的 2 条容量矛盾（feature_ceiling / glass_partition）裁决：两类均为**局部工程量**，非全楼。
quantity_scope_ruling_2026_09_23.pm_wording: 肯定是局部工程量啊 怎么可能全楼都吊顶跟玻璃隔断 吊顶可以占比高毕竟天花无论是什么造型 都是要人工去弄的 但隔断就是根据实际面积实际房间数来的
quantity_scope_ruling_2026_09_23.ceiling_note: 造型吊顶占比可以高（任何造型均须人工逐处制作），但仍按局部工程量计。
quantity_scope_ruling_2026_09_23.partition_note: 玻璃隔断按实际面积与实际房间数计（逐房间立工作面），不随全楼面积线性放大。
quantity_scope_ruling_2026_09_23.consequence: 容量覆盖检验（CAPACITY_COVERAGE_SHORT）对这两条不再以全楼面积作分母质疑 b0——分母错的是检验，不是 b0。两处落 quantity_scope=partial，检验读该字段分流 scope_ruled / genuine。
quantity_scope_ruling_2026_09_23.not_changed: b0/b_min、容量分区、crew_scaling 全部未动——裁决只改**检验语义**，不改任何数值。
